children: on Tuesday posted a 63.4% fall in annual profit, as lower realised pricing and higher unit costs offset increased coal sales.
The coal miner reported net profit after tax of A$161 million ($114.94 million) for the year ended July 31, down from A$439.4 million reported a year earlier.
That missed Visible Alpha estimates of A$182.2 million.
